summary: Build financial KPIs, analyse variances, and create practical dashboards in this five-day course. Explore the outline and enrol.
lede: Strategic financial KPI and dashboard training helps finance professionals connect business priorities with measurable financial results. It covers defining KPI logic, analysing budget-versus-actual variances, building Excel dashboards, and interpreting rolling forecasts to explain performance and inform decisions. Participants also explore financial ratios, Power BI dashboard concepts, data-quality checks, and AI-assisted variance commentary with human review.
audienceIntro: This intermediate financial KPI course is designed for people who produce, interpret, govern, or communicate financial performance measures as part of their regular work. This course is designed for: FP&A analysts preparing budget-versus-actual analysis and rolling forecasts. Management accountants explaining cost variances and financial performance drivers. Finance business partners translating operational changes into financial KPIs. Financial controllers reviewing KPI definitions, reconciliations, and reporting controls. Corporate finance analysts monitoring profitability, liquidity, and capital efficiency ratios. Finance reporting analysts maintaining Excel dashboards and management reporting packs. Budget managers tracking expenditure, commitments, and forecast variances. Finance transformation leads improving reporting workflows and performance data quality. Business unit finance managers presenting results and corrective actions to leadership. Internal auditors reviewing financial KPI lineage, controls, and reporting evidence.
modules: Financial Dashboards in Excel and Power BI
Financial KPI Governance and Data Quality
prerequisites: Working familiarity with budgets, financial statements, or management reports will help you apply the exercises. No programming is required. Basic Excel use is expected; Power BI is introduced at an operational-awareness level, so prior Power BI experience is not required.
